grammar-de-aux-participle-gewesen.explanation: The v2 prompt explicitly requires German AUX participles such as gewesen to use verbForm Part with aspect null; the model instead emitted aspect Perf.

grammar-de-aux-infinitive-sein.explanation: The v2 prompt explicitly says that an auxiliary infinitive used in a clause remains an Inflection Surface and must use verbForm Inf with null mood, person, and tense; the model misclassified sein as a finite indicative form.

grammar-de-aux-modal-wollen-citation.explanation: The input explicitly identifies wollen as a Lexikon Modalauxiliar, and the v2 prompt and analogous dürfen demonstration require Citation for such entry labels; the model incorrectly emitted an Inflection Surface.
